0-0.speaker: caption
0-0.text: Three days ago, the Deepwell drill hit something that bled. Kessa Port has been evacuating ever since.

1-0.speaker: announcer
1-0.text: All civilians to the piers. Do not stop. Stay off open ground.

2-0.speaker: command
2-0.text: Last ship loads in twenty, Warden. Garrison Nine holds the yard till she’s gone.

2-1.speaker: warden
2-1.text: Then we hold the yard. Nobody gets left behind.

3-0.speaker: warden
3-0.text: Ground’s glowing... Contact! They’re coming up through the cracks!

0-0.speaker: command
0-0.text: Last ship’s out. That’s everyone... but us.

1-0.speaker: command
1-0.text: Garrison Nine, the swarm is turning inland, straight for the refinery.

1-1.speaker: warden
1-1.text: They were never chasing people. They’re chasing heat.

2-0.speaker: warden
2-0.text: Eleven million litres of fuel. That’s where we stop them.

0-0.speaker: caption
0-0.text: The Kiln falls, but its core burns on for a full minute.

0-1.speaker: command
0-1.text: Warden... look under the drill tower.

1-0.speaker: command
1-0.text: It’s wide as a street, and it’s breathing. We didn’t find them. We drilled into their house.

2-0.speaker: command
2-0.text: Then we close the door. Seal it, charges at the bottom of the shaft.

3-0.speaker: warden
3-0.text: Garrison Nine, into the cage. We’re going down.

0-0.speaker: command
0-0.text: Two klicks down, charge is set. But the fuse is manual. Someone has to stay.

1-1.speaker: warden
1-1.text: No. Get them to the lift, Hale. That’s an order.

2-0.speaker: command
2-0.text: The shaft’s shaking. Something big’s climbing! Contacts, every crack... hundreds!

3-0.speaker: warden
3-0.text: Seventy-five seconds. Hold the core. Nothing touches that charge.

0-0.speaker: command
0-0.text: Fuse is lit! Lift’s loaded. Warden, get on. Now!

1-0.speaker: caption
1-0.text: The floor of the well splits, and something climbs out. A black dome on crab legs, eight vents burning like furnaces.

1-1.speaker: command
1-1.text: That’s the mother. That’s what they were keeping warm.

2-0.speaker: command
2-0.text: She’s on the charge! If she pulls it loose, it was all for nothing!

2-1.speaker: warden
2-1.text: Then she doesn’t leave the shaft.

3-1.speaker: warden
3-1.text: Take the lift up, Hale. I’ve got her.

0-0.speaker: caption
0-0.text: The last vent bursts, and Ashmaw sinks back into the well she came from.

1-0.speaker: caption
1-0.text: The charge blows, and the Deepwell folds in on her. Without the heat, the Cinderborn slow... then stop... then sleep.

2-0.speaker: command
2-0.text: Lift’s coming back down, Warden. You coming up?

4-0.speaker: caption
4-0.text: Kessa Yard at dawn. Cold, for the first time in weeks.

0-1.speaker: command
0-1.text: Warden’s down! Get up — we hold this together.
